notes.title: COFFIN DANCER SPINNER - MEME OF THE YEAR 2020
notes.content:
To celebrate the [b]meme of the year 2020[/b], the meme born during the coronavirus pandemic, the game has been updated.
Now you can get to the final level of the game to use the ultimate fidget spinner: the [b]Coffin Dancer Spinner
[/b]
In addition, some bugs have been fixed.

So these are the updates:
[list]
 [*]Coffin Dancer Spinner
 [*]Bug Fixes
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29274879/5ff78566f3198597d5a844c301cc129324af3ef9.png[/img]
Thanks to all of the incredible support received for the game, thanks to all your posts in the Hub community we managed to create the best game about the worldwide trend of the Fidget Spinner!
